about:
Rochester Rotational Molding has operated from Rochester, Indiana since its founding in 1988. The company is incorporated as Rochester Rotational Molding, Inc.

The company manufactures rotationally molded plastic products, offering a range that includes safety barriers, water tanks, highway barriers, aeration floats, and parking curbs. In addition to molding, it designs and fabricates molds and components in-house, and provides custom molding services. A dedicated quality assurance staff monitors and checks all products to ensure they meet the RRM seal of approval and exceed customer quality standards.

Its customer base spans sectors that require rotationally molded plastic solutions, such as traffic safety, water storage, highway construction, environmental aeration, and parking infrastructure. The company also lists distributors as a channel for its products.

RRM states that being the actual manufacturer enables continuous product development, competitive pricing, and timely shipping. The company emphasizes developing and designing solutions that add quality, value, and integrity to the products it produces.
